newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil barge premiums firm, but cargoes softe.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil barge premiums firm, but cargoes softe.

text.p: NWE gas oil had a bumpy start to Thursday with fluctuating futures. Premiums for barges were firm, but were weaker for cargoes.
March IPE gas oil was down 50 cents at $165.25 a tonne at 1220 GMT.

Barge premiums gained about 50 cents to March IPE +$1-$2 fob ARA on the back of some short-covering. But, some dealers said swinging futures had pushed some buyers to the sidelines, to be joined by those who feel prices will fall.
Cargo premiums were weaker, although there was buying interest into France.
"I think the weakness has brought out some buying interest," said one trader.
FOD premiums were pegged around March IPE +50 cents on the bid and up to +$2.00 on the offer cif NWE, up to $2.50 easier.
DIN premiums lost their parity with FOD with traders talking of March IPE flat with bids and offers 50 cents either side.
Diesel cargoes were understood to be $1-2 weaker with talk around March IPE +$12-14 cif NWE, although nothing was thought to have traded.
